title: Akvasto Prime
extract:
The Akvasto Prime is the primed version of the  Akvasto revolver, sporting higher offensive stats at some expense to fire rate.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (22.00%)
Above average burst DPS (479.12)
Above average sustained DPS (345.06)
Above average damage per shot (143.88)
Above average total damage (110)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average reload speed (1.40 s)
High ammo max (210)
Above average status chance (22.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average magazine size (12)
Low accuracy (0.50° to 12.00°)
Low fire rate (3.33 attacks/sec)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Akvasto Prime (Normal Attack), compared to  Vasto Prime (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Higher burst DPS (479.12 vs. 359.7)
Higher sustained DPS (345.06 vs. 253.90)
Higher fire rate (3.33 attacks/sec vs. 2.50 attacks/sec)
Larger magazine (12 vs. 6)
Slower reload time (1.40 s vs. 1.00 s)
Higher Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 10)
Lower disposition (●●●●○ (1.20x) vs. ●●●●● (1.35x))
 Akvasto Prime (Normal Attack), compared to  Akvasto (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage per projectile (110.00 vs. 90.00)
Lower  Impact damage ( 16.5 vs.  22.5)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 16.5 vs.  22.5)
Higher  Slash damage ( 77 vs.  45)
Higher total damage (110 vs. 90)
Higher base critical chance (22.00% vs. 16.00%)
Higher base critical multiplier (2.40x vs. 1.80x)
Higher base status chance (22.00% vs. 12.00%)
Higher average damage per tap (143.88 vs. 101.52)
Higher burst DPS (479.12 vs. 338.06)
Higher sustained DPS (345.06 vs. 234.11)
Faster reload time (1.40 s vs. 1.60 s)
More accurate (16 vs. 11.1)
Tighter first-shot spread (0.50° vs. 4.00°)
Tighter maximum spread (12.00° vs. 14.00°)
Higher Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 8)
Lower disposition (●●●●○ (1.20x) vs. ●●●●○ (1.25x))

Acquisition
The Void Relics containing the Akvasto Prime components can be purchased from Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  55,000 and  125 each. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance and this relic may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
